host.description: Network interface to bind to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all, 127.0.0.1 for localhost only).

port.description: TCP port for the HTTP API and media streaming.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS/HTTPS. Requires valid certificate_path and key_path.

certificate_path.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format).

key_path.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format).

level.description: Minimum log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

file.description: Path to log file; leave blank or omit to log to stderr only.

json.description: Enable structured JSON logging (useful for log aggregation systems).

threads.description: Number of worker threads for media processing and transcoding.

segments_path.description: Base directory to store cached HLS/DASH segments and manifests.

hls_enabled.description: Enable HLS playlist generation and streaming.

hls_segment_duration.description: Target duration (in seconds) per HLS segment.

hls_playlist_length.description: Number of recent segments to include in the HLS playlist window.

url.description: Input source URL (e.g., rtsp://, file://, or http://) or device path (e.g., /dev/video0).

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the source.

type.description: Optional type hint (e.g., 'camera', 'file', 'stream') for UI or processing.

sources.description: List of input sources to ingest and stream.
